name: Towers are Hospitals
source:
A visual novel about a chronically ill girl, a mentally ill boy, and the desire for rescue. When reality is a bitter pill to swallow, escapism tastes so similar to love.

[From [url=https://pride-col.itch.io/towers-are-hospitals]itch.io[/url]]

A spinoff of [url=https://terminalstatus.neocities.org/]Terminal Status[/url].
